name: reading-page
title: Reading page
description: A long-form reading page for an article, a blog post or a docs page, built on ReaderLayout from @atom63/ui-react/layout: Page owns the main landmark, Container the width, Section the space around the document, and ReaderLayout a centred reading column with a table-of-contents rail beside it on wide screens. reserveAside keeps the column the same width on pages with no rail. Inside an app shell, give Page render={<div />} so the document keeps one main landmark.
docs: Needs the Atom63 token stack and recipes in your CSS, as an @atom63/create app sets up: https://system.atom63.io/patterns/pattern-templates
